visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit tea shop interior where a female staff member wearing an orange uniform and black gloves handles a large stainless steel pot on the counter. (2) A sequence of close-up shots follows, showing light amber liquid being poured into the pot and then into a measuring cup. (3) Various toppings are highlighted, including translucent brown tea jellies in a container and dark, viscous caramel syrup being drizzled. (4) The camera focuses on the assembly of a drink, showing milk being poured over jellies and thick white milk foam being extruded smoothly onto the surface. (5) An outdoor shot features a finished cup of layered tea sitting on a light-colored wooden table against a background of green foliage. (6) More preparation shots show fresh orange juice with visible pulp being poured into a branded cup, followed by shots of fresh milk tea being mixed. (7) Two orange branded paper cups are held up by hands against a backdrop of hanging green plants. (8) The final shots show the shop's exterior, 'Ye Ting,' characterized by a bold red facade and clear signage, with a delivery person on a scooter briefly passing by.
